question: 哪些 VAV 为 HVAC 区域供风？
pred_sparql:
PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?vav WHERE {
    ?vav rdf:type/rdfs:subClassOf* brick:Variable_Air_Volume_Box .
    ?zone rdf:type/rdfs:subClassOf* brick:Zone .
    ?zone brick:hasPart ?vav .
}
gold_sparql: PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#> SELECT ?vav ?zone WHERE { ?vav a brick:VAV . ?vav brick:feeds ?zone . ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone }
